text:
alex: war room opened — we're seeing a spike of 502/504s for hosted inference in ap-south and ap-northeast since ~09:12 UTC. multiple customers reporting timeouts and retries. paging SRE.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-8773 triggered by high-5xx-rate on hosted-inference-prod (threshold breach).

morgan: looking at ingress logs now. initial signal shows proxy 504s with upstream connection reset at the egress LB. correlating with a deploy around 09:08 UTC.

raj: I rolled a small change to api-proxy (keepalive tweak + connection pool defaults) at 09:06 UTC to address leak in long-lived streams. reverting now.

alex: rollback started. rolling back api-proxy -> v2.14.3 immediately. status?

morgan: ack, saw rollback request. routing table update in progress, should hit all zones in ~60s.

sylvia: adding temporary circuit-breaker config to reduce fanout to inference runtime while we stabilize: set max_concurrent_per_route=8 and increase upstream timeouts to 45s. applying to ap-south & ap-northeast.

raj: revert complete on control plane. canary green for config push.

morgan: after rollback we still see elevated p50/p95 but 5xx rate dropped from 6.7% -> 1.2% in ap-northeast. ap-south still at ~2.8%. working on drain and warmup for KV caches.

jenny: pulled in support leads — customers A, B reported errors and we've issued short update. they asked for ETA on full recovery.

alex: short mitigation summary for comms: rollback proxy change, apply temporary circuit-breaker, increase upstream timeout, warmup KV caches, monitor for 30m.

morgan: quick repro steps we used for engineering: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"test"}' \
  --max-time 20 -v
```
Responses returned: early RST from proxy (502) or 504 after 30s when upstream didn't accept conn. Logs: `upstream read error: connection reset by peer` and `no healthy upstream` in LB.

raj: root cause hypothesis: the keepalive/connection pool tweak reduced timeouts for idle connections, exposing a latent race where runtime would close incoming sockets during heavy fanout. that caused transient upstream resets and LB to mark hosts unhealthy briefly.

sylvia: action items (assigned):
- morgan: collect full ingress+egress traces and timeline, attach correlation ids (due EOD).
- raj: add safe-guard in proxy to tolerate late connection closes for 30s (short-term hotfix) and run canary (due 4h).
- alex: schedule postmortem + customer comms template, coordinate with jenny (due tomorrow 10:00 UTC).
- sylvia: add automated warmup on instance boot to pre-populate KV caches and increase pool size by default (design doc PR, due 3 days).

morgan: I'm uploading logs and a small grafana dashboard snapshot to the incident runbook (link in thread). will include request ids and example trace snippets.

jenny: noted, I'll push a customer update saying rollback completed and we're monitoring; will offer a postmortem once complete.

alex: timeline to close: monitor for 30m, if 5xx <= 0.5% proceed to runbook closeout and start postmortem draft. keep thread updated. :thumbsup:

morgan: 10m post-rollback: metrics trending down. ap-northeast within SLA bands. continuing to watch.

raj: creating PR for proxy tolerance change now (link in thread). will request fast-track review.

sylvia: scheduling postmortem meeting slot for tomorrow 10:00 UTC — invite sent to eng-sre, eng-runtime, product, support.

alex: thanks everyone — great triage. leaving this thread open for postmortem notes and final action items.
